title: Canonical Format: Seller-Rendered Stateful Display
description: Seller-rendered display unit whose declaration is an executable template contract: buyer-known visual states, explicit transitions, breakpoint canvases, and per-state slot bindings. The seller owns the runtime; `supply_mode` declares which end the buyer feeds. Sellers offering `components` or `rendered_canvases` supply mode MUST support `preview_creative` returning a deterministic render of every state × breakpoint from a candidate manifest; the buyer reviews the returned previews before assigning the creative, replacing a separate physical proof round. The `layered_source` mode uses the standard seller-production preview path (`production_window_business_days` applies). Buyer-executable HTML/MRAID is `html5`, a buyer-delivered tag is `display_tag`, arbitrary games/hotspots/scripts remain `custom`, and per-impression algorithmic assembly is `responsive_creative`.

experimental.description: Experimental in AdCP 3.2 while the creative working group gathers implementation evidence across premium web and mobile/app sellers.

v1_translatable.description: No v1 named-format equivalent can express multiple seller-rendered states and their breakpoint bindings.

supply_mode.description: Which end of the template contract the buyer feeds. `components`: buyer supplies component slots; seller renders states (no `state_canvases`/`layered_source` assets allowed). `rendered_canvases`: buyer supplies exactly one `state_canvases` image per declared state × breakpoint pair. `layered_source`: buyer ships design source (+ optional `font_files`); seller production derives states (`production_window_business_days` applies) — transitional for sellers without executable templates.

slots.description: Default manifest slots; which are consumed depends on `supply_mode`. `state_canvases` images MUST carry `state_id` and `breakpoint_id`, and `state_click_urls` entries MUST carry `state_id` (semantic validators resolve the bindings). Component images SHOULD carry `focal_point` for deterministic seller cropping. `landing_page_url` is the default destination (see `clickthrough`). `font_files` MUST contain only buyer-licensed fonts; publisher-proprietary fonts never travel in manifests. Only image, video, text, url, zip, and pixel_tracker slot asset types are accepted — executable types (javascript, html, css, webhook) are rejected even via `slots` overrides.

states.description: Finite visual states known at buy time; state and breakpoint IDs form the canvas-key matrix. Runtime causes live in `transitions[]`. A single-state unit (topscroll, interscroller, skin) declares one state, no transitions, and typically a `reveal` mechanic.

anchoring.description: `underlay` renders the canvas beneath page content, which scrolls over it (IAB New Ad Portfolio underlay class: skins, reveal units). Transitions into `overlay`/`fullscreen_overlay` states SHOULD be user-initiated; non-user-action entries emit LEAN policy warnings.

slot_bindings.description: Asset group IDs rendered in this state (components mode). Makes the template executable: given components and bindings, assembly is deterministic. Every value MUST resolve to a declared slot. Omitted means all supplied component slots may render.

motion.description: Whether the seller-rendered layout animates within this state (attract loops, load animations). Intra-state animation is seller-rendered; buyer canvases stay static images.

max_animation_s.description: Upper bound on intra-state animation duration. Required when `motion` is `animated`.

width_range.description: Inclusive [minimum, maximum] accepted canvas width. The first value MUST be no greater than the second; semantic validators enforce ordering.

width_mode.description: Fluid width classes. `full_bleed`: edge-to-edge viewport width (IAB adhesion, topscroll). `gutter_residual`: the margin remaining beside the page content column (desktop skins). Fluid breakpoints cannot be targeted by `rendered_canvases` supply — semantic validation rejects that pairing.

height_range.description: Inclusive [minimum, maximum] accepted canvas height. The first value MUST be no greater than the second; semantic validators enforce ordering.

viewport_height_percent.description: Height as a percentage of the viewport (topscroll 80%, mobile skin panel 15%). Fluid; cannot be targeted by `rendered_canvases` supply.

canvas_aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio the rendered canvas maintains across the size range (IAB flexible units, ratio-bucket responsive). When both fixed `width` and `height` are declared, the ratio MUST be consistent with them.

close_affordance.description: Whether this state visibly renders a seller-controlled close affordance. When true, rendering MUST follow IAB New Ad Portfolio close-button guidance (top-right, minimum 50×50 dp, available from state entry).

initial_state_id.description: State rendered when the unit first becomes visible. MUST resolve to `states[].state_id`; for a single-state unit it MUST equal the sole state.

reveal.description: How the unit enters view, distinct from state changes. `clip_window`: canvas fixed and progressively exposed through a scrolling window (interscroller, topscroll). `scroll_parallax`: canvas moves at a different rate than content. Reveal is presentation of one canvas, not a transition; do not fabricate a second state to express it.

transitions.description: Bounded seller-rendered transitions between declared visual states. Required when `states` has more than one entry; MUST be omitted for single-state units. Every non-initial state MUST be reachable from `initial_state_id`. Dismissal is terminal unit behavior declared by `user_controls.dismissible`, not a hidden visual state.

transition_id.description: Stable transition identifier for preview and reporting.

trigger.description: Cause of the transition. `timer` counts from state entry; `in_view_timer` counts viewable time in the current state (industry auto-collapse is N seconds in view). `media_event` fires on `video_main` playback milestones. The outcome is expressed separately by `to_state_id`.

input.description: Input driving a user or scroll transition. `hover` expansion is disallowed by IAB NAP guidance and emits a LEAN policy warning visible to buyers.

media_event.description: Playback milestone of `video_main` driving a `media_event` transition (endframes, collapse-on-complete).

direction.description: Scroll direction that arms a `scroll_threshold` transition; enables direction-aware expand/collapse cycles. Re-crossing in the opposite direction does not re-fire this transition.

transition_mode.description: `scroll_linked` continuously interpolates the seller-owned layout between the two declared endpoint states; it is valid only with trigger `scroll_progress` and does not permit buyer scripting.

delay_ms.description: For `timer`: delay after `from_state_id` activates (re-entry restarts it). For `in_view_timer`: accumulated viewable milliseconds in `from_state_id`. Timer-class transitions in a state cycle MUST declare at least 1000 (anti-strobe floor).

duration_ms.description: Duration of a seller-rendered animated transition.

scroll_threshold_percent.description: Viewport/page scroll threshold that starts a `scroll_threshold` transition.

scroll_reference.description: Reference frame for scroll percentages. Progress is `scroll_offset / max(scroll_extent - viewport_extent, 1) * 100`, measured on either the page document or the nearest seller-declared containing scroller.

scroll_start_percent.description: Start of the bounded scroll interval for a `scroll_progress` transition.

scroll_end_percent.description: End of the bounded scroll interval for a `scroll_progress` transition. MUST be greater than `scroll_start_percent`.

preserve_playback.description: Whether `video_main` continues without restart while the seller changes state.

clickthrough.description: Destination policy. `required` (default): manifest MUST supply `landing_page_url`. `optional`: click-optional units (in-feed brand units) may omit it. `none`: unit is non-clickable; manifests MUST NOT supply `landing_page_url` or `state_click_urls`. Per-state overrides via `state_click_urls` entries carrying `state_id`; `landing_page_url` is the fallback for unlisted states.

user_controls.description: When any state anchors as `overlay` or `fullscreen_overlay`, either `dismissible` MUST be true or that state's `close_affordance` MUST be true (dismissibility floor; semantic validators enforce).

canvas_constraints.description: Rectangular areas constraining buyer artwork. Omitted state/breakpoint selectors apply the constraint to every canvas. For fluid or range-sized breakpoints, use percent-unit regions.

duration_ms_range.description: Accepted embedded-video duration [min, max]. `duration_ms_exact` takes precedence when both are present.

max_subload_kb.description: Ceiling on assets loaded after the window load event (IAB LEAN subload). Pairs with `max_initial_load_kb` to mirror the New Ad Portfolio initial/subload weight pair.

polite_load.description: When true, non-initial assets load only after the host page's window load event (IAB LEAN subload boundary).

verifier_constraints.initial_state_resolution: initial_state_id must resolve to a declared state
verifier_constraints.single_state_shape: when states has one entry, transitions must be absent or empty and initial_state_id must equal the sole state; when states has more than one entry, transitions must be present and non-empty
verifier_constraints.transition_exit_determinism: at most one transition out of a given state per cause tuple (trigger, plus input for user_action, media_event for media_event, direction for scroll_threshold); distinct causes may coexist and the seller runtime arms whichever inputs the device supports
verifier_constraints.transition_state_resolution: transition endpoints must resolve to distinct declared states
verifier_constraints.scroll_progress_bounds: scroll_start_percent must be less than scroll_end_percent
verifier_constraints.scroll_linked_binding: transition_mode scroll_linked is valid only with trigger scroll_progress
verifier_constraints.state_reachability: every non-initial state must be reachable from initial_state_id
verifier_constraints.timer_cycle_floor: timer and in_view_timer transitions participating in a state cycle must declare delay_ms >= 1000
verifier_constraints.dismissibility_floor: any state anchored overlay or fullscreen_overlay requires user_controls.dismissible true or that state's close_affordance true
verifier_constraints.breakpoint_id_uniqueness: breakpoints[].breakpoint_id values must be unique within each state
verifier_constraints.width_range_order: width_range minimum must be less than or equal to maximum
verifier_constraints.height_range_order: height_range minimum must be less than or equal to maximum
verifier_constraints.aspect_consistency: canvas_aspect_ratio must be consistent with fixed width and height when both are declared
verifier_constraints.duration_ms_range_order: duration_ms_range[0] must be less than or equal to duration_ms_range[1] when both are non-null
verifier_constraints.motion_animation_bound: max_animation_s is required when a state's motion is animated and forbidden when static
verifier_constraints.slot_binding_resolution: states[].slot_bindings values must resolve to declared slot asset_group_ids
verifier_constraints.allowed_slot_asset_types: declaration slots (including params.slots overrides) must not widen the canonical's allowed asset types; executable types are rejected
verifier_constraints.supply_mode_manifest: components mode forbids state_canvases and layered_source assets; rendered_canvases mode requires full canvas coverage and forbids layered_source; layered_source mode requires a layered_source asset and forbids state_canvases
verifier_constraints.fluid_breakpoint_supply: breakpoints using width_mode or viewport_height_percent cannot be targeted by rendered_canvases supply
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_coverage: in rendered_canvases mode, exactly one state_canvases image per declared state and breakpoint pair
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_dimensions: canvas width must equal declared width or fall within width_range; height must equal fixed height or fall within height_range
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_extras: undeclared and duplicate state/breakpoint pairs are rejected
verifier_constraints.clickthrough_policy: landing_page_url required when clickthrough is required; landing_page_url and state_click_urls forbidden when clickthrough is none
verifier_constraints.state_click_url_resolution: state_click_urls entries must carry state_id resolving to a declared state, with at most one entry per state
verifier_constraints.lean_policy_warnings: non-user-action transitions into overlay/fullscreen_overlay anchoring, hover-triggered expansion, and scroll transitions into overlay anchoring emit policy warnings (non-blocking)
